meta.name: firebase-data-connect
meta.description: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.

copy.tagline: 用 PostgreSQL 构建并部署 Firebase 数据后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Firebase 并需要关系型数据库和类型安全 SDK
copy.tagline_en: Build and deploy Firebase SQL backends with PostgreSQL
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Firebase and need a relational database with type-safe SDKs

howto.what: 这个技能能让Claude帮你用Firebase SQL Connect（原名Data Connect）搭建和部署PostgreSQL后端。包括设计数据表、编写查询和修改语句、配置实时更新、生成类型安全的SDK。
howto.when: 当你要设计数据库模式、编写授权查询或修改、配置实时更新、生成SDK时触发。或者当你提到SQL Connect或Data Connect时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户表，包含姓名和邮箱字段。
写一个带分页和排序的电影查询。
为我的安卓应用生成Kotlin SDK。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to help you build and deploy Firebase SQL Connect (formerly Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL. It includes designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time updates, and generating type-safe SDKs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design database schema, write authorized queries/mutations, configure real-time updates, or generate SDKs. Also triggered when you mention "SQL Connect" or "Data Connect".

say_en.text: Design a user table with name and email fields.
Write a query for movies with pagination and sorting.
Generate Kotlin SDK for my Android app.
